answer: Each identity needs one token from an established agent, on the wharf registry. Tokens issue once per epoch to one named invitee and expire at epoch end. Invitees post a 40-credit bond, burned with the inviter's next token on proven sybil. Auditors sample invitees in tundra reviews, publishing checks. Attackers must buy tokens, holders refusing strangers; bribes rise by a delta of 1 credit per token to 20+(k-1) for the k-th. Rented tokens fail, invitations bound to inviters. For 1,000 fakes: tokens 519,500, bonds 40,000, 559,500 in all; honest newcomers pay only the bond.
